knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, mvtnorm)

Run the entire script to produce *simulated_alien_prototype.csv* for 25 agents.

Script for forward simulation of n agents tracking j prototypes in k dimensions.

Set configs in the following chunk

```{r}
n_agents <- 25
n_dim <- 5
n_prototypes <- 4

#set r and q dists. note they are before log
q_mean <-  -2
q_sd <- 1

r_mean = 0
r_sd = 1

#difference between conditions **
q_mean_diff <- -2
r_mean_diff <- -2


#set starting values for all prototypes
start_mu <- .5
start_sigma <-  10

#save path
save_path <- "simulated_data.csv"

```


## Function definitions
```{r}
#def mvr kalman update for tracking a single prototype one step
mvr_kalman_update <- function(mu_prev_vec, sigma_prev_mat, obs_vec, obs_noise_mat){
  
  #get number of states for matrix construction
  n_dim <- length(mu_prev_vec)
  
  ## Prediction step ## 
  #update mu_pred but assume its constant
  mu_pred_vec <- mu_prev_vec
  
  #update predicted var-covar matrix for state estimate 
  sigma_pred_mat <- sigma_prev_mat
  
  ## Update step ## 
  #Get gain matrix. IE, sigma_prev * (sigma_prev + obs_noise_mat)^{-1}. #maybe add safeguard to matrix-inv
  K_mat = sigma_pred_mat %*% solve(sigma_pred_mat+obs_noise_mat)
  
  #get PE matrix
  PE_vec = obs_vec - mu_pred_vec
  
  #update state vec
  mu_new_vec <- mu_pred_vec + K_mat %*% PE_vec
  
  #Update state var-covariance matrix. (I-K) * sigma_pred. #maybe add numerical safeguard
  sigma_new_mat <- (diag(n_dim) - K_mat) %*% sigma_pred_mat
  
  ## Output ## 
  output_list <- list(mu_vec = mu_new_vec, sigma_mat = sigma_new_mat, K_mat = K_mat )
  return(output_list)
}


#make a function to construct a list of states/prototypes estimates consisting of a location vec, var_covar matrix and an index
construct_state_list <- function(n_dim, n_prototypes, start_mu, start_sigma){
  
  #prep empty list
  state_list <- vector("list", n_prototypes)

  # make a state for each prototype
  for (i in 1:n_prototypes){
    #make state of correct number of dimensions
    state <- list(mu = rep(start_mu, n_dim), sigma = diag(start_sigma, n_dim), state_index = i, log_p = NULL, choice = NULL)
    
    #store in list
    state_list[[i]] <- state
  } 
  return (state_list)
}


#function for updating all prototypes/state estimates within in a trial. Update this to return choice as well**
update_prototypes <- function(trial_features, trial_feedback, state_list, agent_obs_noise_mat, agent_process_noise_mat){
    
    n_states <- length(state_list)
      
    ## Then loop over all prototypes / states on the trial and update them
    for (j in 1:n_states){
      
      #getvals for current prototype on trial
      mu_vec <- state_list[[j]]$mu
      sigma_mat <- state_list[[j]]$sigma + agent_process_noise_mat #adding drift
      state_type <- state_list[[j]]$state_index
      
      
      ## get prob of choosing prototype
      prototype_sigma <-sigma_mat + agent_obs_noise_mat
      state_list[[j]]$log_p <- dmvnorm(trial_features, mean = mu_vec, sigma = prototype_sigma, log = TRUE)
      
      #if prototype index corresponds to feedback then do a kalman update and update corresponding state/prototype
      if (trial_feedback == state_type){

        
        #do kalman update
        update <- mvr_kalman_update(mu_prev_vec = mu_vec, 
                                    sigma_prev_mat = sigma_mat,
                                    obs_vec = trial_features, 
                                    obs_noise_mat = agent_obs_noise_mat)
      
        #update the state list
        state_list[[j]]$mu <- update$mu_vec
        state_list[[j]]$sigma <- update$sigma_mat
        
        #get k for storage
        K_mat <- update$K_mat
      }
      
      #else just update drifted simga state_list with drift
      else{
        #
        state_list[[j]]$sigma <- sigma_mat
        
      }
    }
  return (state_list)
}

#stable log from course notes:
log_sum_exp <- function(v) {
    m <- max(v)
    m + log(sum(exp(v - m)))
  }

#function from sampling a choice given a state list of prototypes containing log props 
sample_choice <- function(state_list){
  n_states = length(state_list)
  
  log_p_vec <- numeric(n_states)
  #loop over states
  for (i in 1:n_states){
    #get log props
    log_p_vec[i] <- state_list[[i]]$log_p
  }
  
  #get denominator to normalize log_props
  log_denom <- log_sum_exp(log_p_vec)
  
  #make new vec for storing
  p_vec <- numeric(n_states)
  
  #calc normalized propabilities
  for (i in 1:n_states){
    p_vec[i] <- exp(log_p_vec[i] - log_denom)
  }
  
  #sample a choice
  choice <- sample(c(1:n_states), size = 1, prob=p_vec)
  
return(choice)
}

# make a function for looping over all trials for a single agent
#where:
  #features is list of n_dim vectors. One for each trial
  #feedback is a list of ints describing the state type one for each trial
agent_loop <- function(n_dim, n_prototypes, n_trials, features, feedback, agent_obs_noise, agent_process_noise, start_mu, start_sigma){
  
  ### setup agent ###
  #make agent observation noise matrix (R)
  agent_obs_noise_mat = agent_obs_noise * diag(n_dim)
    
  #make agent process noise matrix (Q)
  agent_process_noise_mat = agent_process_noise * diag(n_dim)
  
  #build a state_list of prototypes. One for each prototype 
  state_list <- construct_state_list(n_dim = n_dim, n_prototypes = n_prototypes, start_mu, start_sigma)
  
  #prep empty list to store state, obs and k for each trial
  results <- vector("list", n_trials)
  
  ### run trials ###
  for (i in 1:n_trials){
    
    ## on trial:
    #get features.     "Should prop check that features and n_dim match"
    trial_features <- features[[i]]
    
    #get feedback, ie what state type was the trial
    trial_feedback <- feedback[i] 
    
    # Then loop over all prototypes / states on the trial and update according to kalman filter if state is the same as observed, 
    # if not just add process noise. Returns list of updated state list and p for each
    state_list <- update_prototypes(trial_features = trial_features,
                                    trial_feedback = trial_feedback,
                                    state_list = state_list,
                                    agent_obs_noise_mat = agent_obs_noise_mat,
                                    agent_process_noise_mat = agent_process_noise_mat)
    
    #make choice given the log props of stimulus being each prototype
    choice <- sample_choice(state_list)
  
    
    #make newlinw

  
  
    #store the state_list and behavoir
    results[[i]] <- list(state_list=state_list, choice=choice)
  }
  #return results
  return(results)
}


# make function for shuffling stimuli presentation according to experiment description
make_stimuli_order <- function(){
  
  
  stimuli_combinations <- do.call(expand_grid, setNames(rep(list(0:1), n_dim), paste0("dim_", 1:n_dim)))
  
  num_stimuli = 32
  num_blocks = 3

  blocks <- vector("list", num_blocks)

  for (i in 1:num_blocks){
    stimuli_order <- stimuli_combinations[sample(num_stimuli), ]
    blocks[[i]] <- stimuli_order %>% 
      mutate(block = i, trial_id = 1:num_stimuli)
  }

  ##HAVENT CHECKED RULES THROUGH** 
  bind_rows(blocks) %>%
    mutate(
      danger = case_when(
        block == 1 ~ as.integer(dim_1 == 1 & dim_3 == 1),
        block == 2 ~ as.integer(dim_4 == 1),
        block == 3 ~ as.integer(dim_4 == 1 & dim_5 == 1)
      ),
      nutrition = case_when(
        block == 1 ~ as.integer(dim_4 == 1),
        block == 2 ~ as.integer(dim_1 + dim_2 + dim_3 >= 2),
        block == 3 ~ as.integer(dim_1 + dim_2 + dim_3 + dim_5 >= 2)
      ), 
      #"Responses are 1-4, 
      #where 3 and 4 indicate danger, 
      #1 and 2 not danger; 
      #2 and 4 indicate nutritious,
      #1 and 3 not nutritious"
      feedback = case_when(
        danger == 0 & nutrition == 0 ~ 1,
        danger == 0 & nutrition == 1 ~ 2,
        danger == 1 & nutrition == 0 ~ 3,
        danger == 1 & nutrition == 1 ~ 4
      )
    ) 
}

#def function to loop over number of agents
sim_agents <- function(n_agents, q_mean, q_sd, r_mean, r_sd, start_mu, start_sigma, condition = "A"){

  agent_results <- vector("list", n_agents)

  #loop over agents
  for (i in 1:n_agents){

    #sample vals on log scale directly
    log_q <- rnorm(1, mean = q_mean, sd = q_sd)
    log_r <- rnorm(1, mean = r_mean, sd = r_sd)

    #shuffle stimuli order within each block and evaluate changing rules for all stimuli
    stimuli_df <- make_stimuli_order()

    # get all stimuli out
    features <- pmap(stimuli_df %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("dim_")), c)
    
    #get all stimuli 
    feedback  <- stimuli_df$feedback  

    #loop over trials
    results <- agent_loop(n_dim = n_dim,
                          n_prototypes = 4,
                          n_trials = nrow(stimuli_df),
                          features = features,
                          feedback = feedback,
                          agent_obs_noise = exp(log_r),
                          agent_process_noise = exp(log_q),
                          start_mu = start_mu, 
                          start_sigma = start_sigma)

    #store everything
    choices <- sapply(results, `[[`, "choice")
    agent_results[[i]] <- list(
      trial_df = bind_cols(
        tibble(
          subject_id = i,
          trial      = seq_along(results),
          block      = stimuli_df$block,
          choice     = choices
        ),
        stimuli_df %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("dim_")),
        tibble(
          feedback         = feedback,
          danger_true      = stimuli_df$danger,
          nutrition_true   = stimuli_df$nutrition,
          danger_choice    = as.integer(choices %in% c(3, 4)),
          nutrition_choice = as.integer(choices %in% c(2, 4)),
          log_q            = log_q,
          log_r            = log_r,
          condition        = condition
        )
      ),
      state_trajectories = lapply(results, `[[`, "state_list")
    )
  }
  return(agent_results)
}

```


# Run simulation
```{r}
results_A <- sim_agents(n_agents = n_agents,
                        q_mean = q_mean,
                        q_sd = q_sd,
                        r_mean = r_mean,
                        r_sd = r_sd,
                        start_mu = start_mu,
                        start_sigma = start_sigma,
                        condition = "A")

#sim condition b with offsets
results_B <- sim_agents(n_agents = n_agents,
                        q_mean = q_mean+q_mean_diff,
                        q_sd = q_sd,
                        r_mean = r_mean+r_mean_diff,
                        r_sd = r_sd,
                        start_mu = start_mu,
                        start_sigma = start_sigma,
                        condition = "B")

output_df <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(lapply(results_A, `[[`, "trial_df")),
  bind_rows(lapply(results_B, `[[`, "trial_df"))
) 
```


```{r}
#rename features for stan and only keep condition A
output_df %>% 
  rename(eyes = dim_1,
         buffness = dim_2,
         arms = dim_3,
         spots = dim_4,
         color = dim_5) %>% 
  filter(condition == "A")  %>% 
  write_csv(save_path)
```


## Plotting accuracy
```{r}
accuracy_df_100 <- map_dfr(c(results_A, results_B), function(agent) {
  agent$trial_df %>%
    mutate(
      trial_in_block = ((trial - 1) %% 32) + 1,
      correct        = as.integer(choice == feedback)
    ) %>%
    group_by(block) %>%
    mutate(cumulative_accuracy = cumsum(correct) / trial_in_block) %>%
    ungroup()
})

accuracy_df_100 %>%
  group_by(condition, block, trial_in_block) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(cumulative_accuracy),
    lo       = quantile(cumulative_accuracy, 0.1),
    hi       = quantile(cumulative_accuracy, 0.9),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = trial_in_block, y = mean_acc, color = condition, fill = condition)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  facet_wrap(~block, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "Trial within block", y = "Cumulative Accuracy",
       caption = "Line = mean, ribbon = 80% interval across agents") +
  theme_minimal()


# danger and nutrition accuracy
accuracy_df_100 %>%
  mutate(
    danger_correct    = as.integer(danger_choice == danger_true),
    nutrition_correct = as.integer(nutrition_choice == nutrition_true)
  ) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, condition, block) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_acc_danger    = cumsum(danger_correct) / trial_in_block,
    cum_acc_nutrition = cumsum(nutrition_correct) / trial_in_block
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(cum_acc_danger, cum_acc_nutrition),
               names_to = "category", values_to = "cat_accuracy",
               names_prefix = "cum_acc_") %>%
  group_by(condition, block, trial_in_block, category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(cat_accuracy),
    lo       = quantile(cat_accuracy, 0.1),
    hi       = quantile(cat_accuracy, 0.9),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = trial_in_block, y = mean_acc, color = condition, fill = condition)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  facet_grid(category ~ block, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "Trial within block", y = "Cumulative Accuracy",
       caption = "Line = mean, ribbon = 80% interval across agents") +
  theme_minimal()
```
